WillScript_WillBeforeText:
Welcome to #MON
LEAGUE, {PLAYER}.

Allow me to intro-
duce myself. I am WILL.

I have trained all
around the world,

making my psychic
#MON powerful.

And, at last, I've
been accepted into the ELITE FOUR.

I can only keep
getting better!

Losing is not an
option!
WillScript_WillDefeatText:
Even though I was
defeated, I won't change my course.

I will continue
battling until I

stand above all
trainers!

Now, {PLAYER}, move
on and experience

the true ferocity
of the ELITE FOUR.
